name: Env Sentinel
problem: Environment-variable usage, example contracts, and local configuration drift apart and cause late deployment failures.
purpose: A dependency-free local CLI that statically scans source references and compares key names with dotenv contract and configuration files without exposing values.

major_features: Interactive canvas with drag-and-drop text overlays
Real-time relative luminance mapping for gradients and images
Instant WCAG AA/AAA compliance scoring and color suggestions
name: Contrast Canvas
problem: Testing WCAG accessibility contrast ratios for complex UI components like gradients, text over images, and multi-state buttons is tedious with standard single-color pickers.
purpose: A local-first visual canvas where users can paste mockups, apply dynamic CSS gradients, overlay text elements, and instantly view a live, multi-point WCAG AA/AAA contrast map showing exactly which pixels fail contrast requirements.
